title: ARIRANG World Tour Night 3 — Mexico City Grand Finale at Estadio GNP Seguros: Three-Night Run Closes to 45,000+
detail: BTS closes the Mexico City leg of the ARIRANG World Tour on May 10, 2026 with a grand finale at Estadio GNP Seguros — the third and final night of a historic three-concert run (May 7, 9, 10) that brings the total audience to approximately 136,000+ fans. Night 3 is the most emotionally charged of the three performances: RM delivers a full farewell address in Spanish, drawing tears from fans throughout the 45,000-capacity stadium. The closing night features a culminating surprise song rotation — 'Spring Day' is performed for the first time on the ARIRANG World Tour, eliciting one of the tour's loudest crowd reactions. 'Dynamite' closes the main set ahead of a three-song encore capped by a synchronized fireworks display visible from surrounding streets. V's brief Spanish greeting — 'México, los llevamos en el corazón para siempre' ('Mexico, we carry you in our hearts forever') — goes viral on Weverse and social media within minutes of the show's end. Billboard's wrap-up of all three Mexico City nights praises the GNP Seguros run as 'the defining K-pop event of 2026' and underlines BTS's sustained commercial and emotional grip on Latin American ARMY. With the CDMX leg now complete, the ARIRANG World Tour advances to Las Vegas (Allegiant Stadium, May 23–28), where BTS is expected to perform six nights for an estimated 75,000+ fans per night.

title: Jin and BTS Members Attend Lucha Libre at Arena México — Místico Wears BTS-Embroidered Jacket
detail: On May 10, 2026, Jin and three other BTS members attend a lucha libre event at Arena México — one of Mexico City's most storied wrestling venues and a cultural landmark. The visit, reported by StarNews Korea, draws widespread attention when pro-wrestling star Místico appears in the ring wearing a white jacket embroidered with 'BTS' and the name of each member, a spontaneous tribute that is captured on fan video and shared widely across social media. Jin poses for photographs ringside and is seen enjoying the event enthusiastically. The cultural outing is framed by media as an example of BTS's deep engagement with Mexican culture during their ARIRANG World Tour visit — going beyond the stage to connect with fans and local traditions. The images resonate broadly among ARMY in Latin America, who share screenshots of the members inside the famous arena with captions celebrating the cross-cultural moment. The visit also helps offset some of the negative press surrounding the Ticketmaster México controversy from Night 1.
